questions.question_text: Analyze how 'Magnifying Glass' inspires scientific curiosity and artistic wonder simultaneously.
questions.correct_answer: Walter de la Mare shows that science and poetry are twin avenues of wonder. Scientifically, the poem celebrates optical physics and keen observation. Artistically, it uses rich metaphors—turning chalk into snow caverns and moss into fairy woods. By proving that ordinary, overlooked things hold hidden worlds of beauty, the poem encourages students to question surface appearances and explore nature deeply.
